mechanism_of_action: Peptide co-agonist at the GLP-1 and glucagon (GCG) receptors.
efficacy_outcome: At 19 weeks, cotadutide 600 μg versus placebo reduced absolute hepatic fat fraction by 5.0 percentage points (95% CI, −8.5 to −1.5), ALT by 23.5 U/L (95% CI, −47.1 to −1.8), and AST by 16.8 U/L (95% CI, −33.0 to −0.8).
safety_signal: Any-grade treatment-emergent adverse events occurred in 91.7% with 600 μg, 76.9% with 300 μg, and 37.5% with placebo; events were mostly mild-to-moderate gastrointestinal events. Discontinuations due to these events occurred in 16.7%, 7.7%, and 4.2%, respectively.
